1. Start dogfooding today (five minutes). Add a shell alias like alias cc='pbpaste | cleancopy clean | pbcopy' and run it on real copies as you work. The engine is now at the ceiling reachable with synthetic fixtures — every further improvement needs real misses, and each one becomes a permanent fixture. The --explain view we built is exactly the tool for diagnosing them in seconds. This costs nothing and starts the quality flywheel before any native code exists.
